SFixture: John 8, in the words of the WEB
Pm
V1
Tbut Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
Pm
V2
TNow very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.
V3
TThe scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,
V4
Tthey told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.
V5
TNow in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”
V6
TThey said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of.
Pm
V7
TBut when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them,
W “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”
V8
TAgain he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
Pm
V9
TThey, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.
V10
TJesus, standing up, saw her and said,
W “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”
Pm
V11
TShe said, “No one, Lord.”
Pm
V12
TAgain, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying,
W “I am the light of the world.
W He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
Pm
V13
TThe Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”
Pm
V14
TJesus answered them,
W “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.
V15
WYou judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.
V16
WEven if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.
V17
WIt’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
V18
WI am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”
Pm
V19
TThey said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?”
Pm
V20
TJesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
V21
TJesus said therefore again to them,
W “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”
Pm
V22
TThe Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says,
W ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’
T?”
Pm
V23
THe said to them,
W “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.
V24
WI said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am
W he, you will die in your sins.”
Pm
V25
TThey said therefore to him, “Who are you?”
Pm
V26
WI have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”
Pm
V27
TThey didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.
V28
TJesus therefore said to them,
W “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.
V29
WHe who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”
Pm
V30
TAs he spoke these things, many believed in him.
V31
TJesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him,
W “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
V32
WYou will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
Pm
V33
TThey answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say,
W ‘You will be made free’
T?”
Pm
V34
TJesus answered them,
W “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
V35
WA bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
V36
WIf therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
V37
WI know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
V38
WI say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”
Pm
V39
TThey answered him, “Our father is Abraham.”
Pm
V40
WBut now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.
V41
WYou do the works of your father.”
Pm
V42
TTherefore Jesus said to them,
W “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.
V43
WWhy don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.
V44
WYou are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.
V45
WBut because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.
V46
WWhich of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
V47
WHe who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”
Pm
V48
TThen the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”
Pm
V49
TJesus answered,
W “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
V50
WBut I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.
V51
WMost certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”
Pm
V52
TThen the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say,
W ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’
V53
TAre you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”
Pm
V54
TJesus answered,
W “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.
V55
WYou have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.
V56
WYour father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”
Pm
V57
TThe Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”
Pm
V58
TJesus said to them,
W “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.
W”
Pm
V59
TTherefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.
